user.title: Public Lands
user.description: Identify the public land at your location.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Public Lands is already set up.

init.title: Public Lands options
init.description: Choose where your location comes from and which optional sensors to add. Optional sensors update when you press Refresh USPL.

data_description.location_entity: A zone, device tracker, person or sensor with latitude and longitude. The default is zone.home.
data_description.city_county: Adds USPL City, USPL County and USPL State from the U.S. Census Bureau. Useful for city overnight-parking rules.
data_description.campgrounds: Adds USPL Nearby Campgrounds from Recreation.gov. Needs your own free API key.
data_description.ridb_api_key: Get a free key by signing up at ridb.recreation.gov. Your key stays on your Home Assistant.
data_description.search_radius: How far to look for campgrounds, from 10 to 25 miles (25 is Recreation.gov's maximum).

error.no_coordinates: That entity has no latitude and longitude right now.
error.api_key_required: Enter your Recreation.gov API key to turn on nearby campgrounds.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Recreation.gov to check the key. Try again later.

lookup.name: Look up a location
lookup.description: Looks up the public land at a coordinate and returns the result without changing the sensors. Leave the coordinates empty to use the current location. The rules link and any optional features that are switched on are included.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude to look up. Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude to look up. Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.
